extensionDescription.message: Provides a WebUSB (navigator.usb) compatible polyfill in Firefox. Access to real USB devices happens through a local native messaging host (a separate process).

statusNotConnectedDetailFallback.message: fox-webusb-host may not be installed. See the setup steps on the options page.

leadTextAfterLink.message: is "harmful"). This extension provides an equivalent API by accessing real USB devices through a locally running native messaging host (a Python process).

setupStep1.message: Make sure Python 3.9 or newer is installed.

setupStep2Intro.message: In the native-host/ folder bundled with this add-on, run:

setupStep3Intro.message: (Optional, recommended) For faster base64 handling, with a Rust toolchain (rustc/cargo, 1.74+) available:

setupStep3Note.message: Everything still works fully with the plain Python implementation even without building this.

setupStep4.message: Load this extension from "Load Temporary Add-on" at about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox (select extension/manifest.json).
